data.name: plans
constraints: CHECK (schedule <> 'every_n_days' OR (interval_days IS NOT NULL AND interval_days > 0))
CHECK (schedule <> 'weekdays' OR (weekdays IS NOT NULL AND weekdays BETWEEN 1 AND 127))
CHECK (schedule <> 'once' OR due_at IS NOT NULL)
CHECK (notify_minute IS NULL OR notify_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)

columns.name: plan_id
columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

data.name: one_active_walk_per_pet
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_walk_per_pet ON entries (pet_id) WHERE type = 'walk' AND ended_at IS NULL

data.name: one_avatar_per_pet

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sex" TEXT NULL, "neutered" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("neutered" IN (0, 1)), "birth_date" TEXT NULL, "birth_precision" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'day', "home_date" TEXT NULL, "breed_code" TEXT NULL, "breed_name" TEXT NULL, "breed_group" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mixed', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pet_presets" ("pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "meal_amount" REAL NULL, "meal_unit" TEXT NULL, "meals_per_day" INTEGER NULL, "bowl_ml" REAL NULL, "weight_cadence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly', "quick_types" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '["meal","water","potty","brushing"]', PRIMARY KEY ("pet_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "entry_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_kind" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "schedule" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval_days" INTEGER NULL, "weekdays" INTEGER NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NULL, "notify_minute" INTEGER NULL, "snoozed_until" INTEGER NULL, "notification_id" INTEGER NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paused" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (schedule <> 'every_n_days' OR (interval_days IS NOT NULL AND interval_days > 0)), CHECK (schedule <> 'weekdays' OR (weekdays IS NOT NULL AND weekdays BETWEEN 1 AND 127)), CHECK (schedule <> 'once' OR due_at IS NOT NULL), CHECK (notify_minute IS NULL OR notify_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "amount" REAL NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "distance_m" REAL NULL, "details" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "label" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "params" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "dismissed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dismissed" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weather_days" ("day" TEXT NOT NULL, "max_c" REAL NOT NULL, "min_c" REAL NOT NULL, "precip_prob" INTEGER NOT NULL, "uv_max" REAL NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("day"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pet_photos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_path" TEXT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NULL, "original_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "caption" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "captured_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_avatar" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_avatar" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "mood_emoji" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_media_refs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memory_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX entries_pet_occurred ON entries (pet_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX entries_pet_type_occurred ON entries (pet_id, type, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX entries_plan ON entries (plan_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_walk_per_pet ON entries (pet_id) WHERE type = 'walk' AND ended_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX plans_pet ON plans (pet_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX card_history_pet_day_key ON card_history (pet_id, day, card_key)
CREATE INDEX pet_photos_pet_created ON pet_photos (pet_id, created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_avatar_per_pet ON pet_photos (pet_id) WHERE is_avatar = 1
CREATE INDEX memory_entries_pet_occurred ON memory_entries (pet_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX memory_media_entry_position ON memory_media_refs (entry_id, position)
